import os

source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    cw = [[grid[n - 1 - c][r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    ccw = [[grid[c][n - 1 - r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    half = [[grid[n - 1 - r][n - 1 - c] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    out = []
    for r in range(n):
        out.append(list(grid[r]) + cw[r])
    for r in range(n):
        out.append(ccw[r] + half[r])
    return out
'''
